requirements.title: Boot sequence
requirements.rule: Each fresh agent reads project/current state and reports active objective, priority, handoff and unresolved blockers.

requirements.title: Authority ordering
requirements.rule: Explicit owner authorization and accepted ADRs override proposed agent decisions; conflicts are surfaced.

requirements.title: Owner decision trace
requirements.rule: Scope-changing decisions must link to a recorded owner decision; no implicit approval.

requirements.title: Task identity
requirements.rule: Every meaningful change has unique durable ID, objective, classification, required IDs and scoped files.

requirements.title: Stage ordering
requirements.rule: Review, Plan, Implement, Validate, Document, Handoff occur in order with recorded evidence.

requirements.title: Observed validation
requirements.rule: Commands must actually run; record exit, time, argv, scope fingerprint, never fabricated success.

requirements.title: Completeness gate
requirements.rule: No task completes while required sections, checks, status/changelog and handoff are missing.

requirements.title: Resumption
requirements.rule: Active and blocked tasks retain next executable action, unknowns and links without chat memory.

requirements.title: Change traceability
requirements.rule: PR changed paths are covered by a completed task record included in the PR.

requirements.title: Secrets and privacy
requirements.rule: No secret, tokens, private member payload, or unredacted provider logs in governance records.

requirements.title: Deployment separation
requirements.rule: An implemented/reviewed change is not proof of service deployment; activation requires owner scope.

requirements.title: Product truthfulness
requirements.rule: Unbuilt lineup, waiver, trade, draft and projection features cannot be called released.

requirements.title: Model lineage
requirements.rule: Model data sources/target/cutoff are protected by accepted ADR-006, with ADR-007 still proposed.

requirements.title: Model vs adviser
requirements.rule: Advisory external research is segregated from nflverse-only statistical Model inputs and targets.

requirements.title: League specificity
requirements.rule: ESPN league context, scoring/slots/locks/availability are read, not assumed.

requirements.title: Testing by change class
requirements.rule: Validation checklist is selected from declared code area and missing checks block closure.

requirements.title: Conflicting evidence
requirements.rule: New findings that contradict prior conclusions require explicit reconciliation record.

requirements.title: Cross-agent portability
requirements.rule: Codex and Claude share root authority, while tool-specific hooks cannot be treated as universal.

requirements.title: Handoff precision
requirements.rule: Record exact next action, location, prerequisites, files and unresolved decisions.

requirements.title: Human review boundary
requirements.rule: Code CI does not prove product semantics or approvals; protected branches and review remain required.
